title: Build a causal Transformer training and inference harness
hardware: CPU reference; physical TPU and multi-controller qualification remain separate

stages.title: Tokens, causal computation and loss
stages.evidence: UTF-8 byte contracts, disjoint document/content provenance, independent attention and token-normalized objective
stages.expected: PASS stage 1: UTF-8 bytes, split/content provenance, independent attention and masked token loss, causal invariance
stages.diagnosis: Inspect shifted targets, padded-key and future masks, normalization and valid-token denominators before adding model capacity.

stages.title: Actual training and full recovery
stages.evidence: Gradient comparison, trained Transformer, fresh-process Adam/dropout/order recovery and fixed held-out token metrics
stages.expected: PASS stage 2: derivative check, full Adam/dropout/iterator fresh-process recovery, actual training and fixed token evaluation
stages.diagnosis: Compare the next document IDs and dropout keys before parameters; preserve both Adam moments and the completed step.

stages.title: Real KV-cache precision
stages.evidence: Sequential cached/full parity under FP32/BF16/INT8, stored dtype/scale evidence, immutable prefix and overflow rejection
stages.expected: PASS stage 3: actual FP32/BF16/INT8 KV storage, sequential cached/full parity, immutable prefix, overflow and independent integer arithmetic
stages.diagnosis: Separate a broken cache transition from quantization error by comparing the same policy first.

stages.title: Exported inference and profiler evidence
stages.evidence: Six real endpoints, fresh-process reload, bounded generation, synchronized prefill/decode measurements and actual profiler trace
stages.expected: PASS stage 4: six serialized endpoints, fresh-process inference, corruption rejection, bounded generation and actual prefill/decode timing
stages.diagnosis: Verify actual artifact hashes and context length, then inspect the declared timed and traced boundaries.

rubric: Explain UTF-8 tokens, causal/padding masks and valid-token loss normalization
Train a real tiny Transformer and compare fixed held-out token evidence with a declared baseline
Recover optimizer, dropout and document-order state in a fresh process
Verify sequential cache parity and actual cache precision/storage boundaries
Reload real prefill/decode exports and reject corrupted or over-context requests
Retain real profiler traces and synchronized CPU measurements with workload units
Explain actual generation successes and failures without natural-language quality claims
Keep physical TPU and distributed qualification distinct from the CPU training-system capstone
setupNote: Use the extracted ZIP top folder containing requirements-cpu.txt and projects/text-harness. The README explains the full connected runner and actual plots/profile artifacts. Linked TPU/distributed phase commands require the full course workspace and an existing supported target environment.
